answer: To resist sybils each agent must mint an ivory lotus certificate by solving a personalized sequential SHA-256 puzzle seeded with its address and the current epoch. The puzzle requires roughly 30 seconds of single-thread CPU work that cannot be precomputed. Verification costs one hash. Even under a gale of parallel hardware the sequential depth forces linear wall-clock or power cost per extra identity. Creating 1000 fakes demands 1000x30s of real compute or detectable high-power signatures, making mass fabrication uneconomic versus honest single-agent work.
